headline: BSI (BRIS) Acknowledges Rights Issue Could Reduce Earnings Per Share
summary: Bank Syariah Indonesia, BSI, plans a second-phase rights issue to support business growth and adjust its shareholding structure. The company acknowledged the move could pressure earnings per share.
why: Bank Syariah Indonesia is a major Islamic bank listed in Jakarta. Rights issues raise new capital but increase the share count, which can dilute per-share earnings for existing holders.
original_headline: BSI (BRIS) Akui Rights Issue Berpotensi Tekan Laba Per Saham
